2607.24625.title: Agentic Permissions Policy Algebra for Taint Confinement in LLM Agents
2607.24625.paper_summary: Autonomous LLM agents processing mixed-confidentiality data face severe security risks from prompt injection attacks and reasoning errors. While dynamic Information Flow Control (IFC) provides structural security guarantees, traditional taint tracking permanently taints an agent's context upon reading unvetted data, severely restricting downstream utility. We present APPA (Agentic Permissions Policy Algebra), an IFC framework that resolves this usability bottleneck through engine-managed context branching and prospective acquisition enforcement. Before data acquisition occurs, APPA prospectively evaluates label descents and missing prerequisites, generating actionable remedy plans (Authorize, Accept). To inspect unvetted data without polluting the primary context, a label-seeded child trajectory is spawned, absorbing label descent locally and allowing a trusted sanitizer to return a bounded derivative to the unchanged parent. Governed by a two-monoid model over security labels and shared event logs, we formally prove parent label preservation and merge confinement. Finally, we evaluate APPA on a multi-turn tool-chaining benchmark across four models: it suppresses exfiltration (31%-50% down to 0%-7% attack success), and on three of the four, branching recovers a substantial share of the utility that taint tracking alone forfeits.
2607.24625.paper_summary_zh: 自主 LLM 代理處理混合保密數據面臨著來自提示注入攻擊和推理錯誤的嚴重安全風險。雖然動態信息流控制 (IFC) 提供結構性安全保障，但傳統的污點追蹤在讀取未經審核的數據後會永久污染代理的上下文，嚴重限制下游的效用。我們提出了 APPA（代理權限政策代數），這是一個 IFC 框架，通過引擎管理的上下文分支和前瞻性獲取強制執行來解決這一可用性瓶頸。在數據獲取發生之前，APPA 前瞻性地評估標籤下降和缺失的前提條件，生成可行的補救計劃（授權、接受）。為了在不污染主要上下文的情況下檢查未經審核的數據，生成了一個標籤種子子軌跡，當地吸收標籤下降，並允許受信任的清理器將有界導數返回給未改變的父上下文。在安全標籤和共享事件日誌上由雙單子模型治理，我們正式證明了父標籤的保留和合併限制。最後，我們在四個模型的多輪工具鏈基準上評估了 APPA：它抑制了數據外洩（攻擊成功率從 31%-50% 降至 0%-7%），在四個模型中的三個上，分支恢復了污點追蹤單獨放棄的相當一部分效用。
